description: PROVISIONAL 24-10-2026. One band covers the whole day; no day/night split has been given (05A23D, reciprocal runway operations, is a night mode, 11pm to 5:30am, in the public material, but that is not applied). Order is the owner's preferred runway mode list, strict: 1 05A23D; 2 23AD; 3 05AD. The penalties are placeholders on the same scale as the other packs (0, 2, 5) for the owner to confirm.
